name: Integer fee quote
description: Quote 25 basis points using integer units rounded down. Retain the exact division remainder. Preserve the previous quote if amount times 25 would overflow u64.
specification: if amount ≤ 737869762948382064 then { units := amount * 25 / 10000, remainder := amount * 25 % 10000 } else s

properties.name: exact_split
properties.description: The rounded units and remainder exactly account for the scaled amount.

properties.name: remainder_bound
properties.description: Successful quotes retain a remainder strictly below the divisor.

properties.name: overflow_preserves_quote
properties.description: Unrepresentable intermediate products leave both previous fields unchanged.

assumptions: Amounts are integer minor units; the quoted rate is exactly 25/10000.
The caller uses this pure quote function. Account authorization, posting, persistence and settlement are outside this contract.
